Lena Park: Postmortem follow-up for the metering incident (late ingest + duplicate token attribution). Quick summary: delayed consumer commits + occasional at-least-once writes caused ~30% overcount on some invoices. Need owners for remediation, backfill, and customer comms.

Omar Ruiz: I'll take the backfill + idempotent write work. Planning a small-batch job with per-invoice checksums so we can safely resume.

Tess Wilkerson: I'll run invoice dry-runs and produce final credit amounts. Need CSV of impacted invoices with token deltas.

Lena Park: Tentative owners/dates (confirm):
- Omar Ruiz — backfill job (batching + resume/locks) — due 2025-12-02
- Tess Wilkerson — invoice dry-run + credit table — due 2025-12-03
- Ravi Menon — producer/consumer commit audit + retry-policy tweak — due 2025-11-30
- Claire Ho — customer comms + legal-approved memo — due 2025-12-04
Please ACK and update if any date is a problem.

BillingBot: ALERT: 67 customers flagged. Estimated total credit exposure = $9,200. See ticket BILL-2290 for details.

Ravi Menon: Root cause notes: consumer lag during 2025-11-28 02:15 UTC spike; our consumer committed offsets after retries, which allowed duplicates to be reprocessed. I'll add stronger idempotency keys upstream and lower the retry window.

Omar Ruiz: Backfill approach (high level):
1) compute canonical_token_count per invoice_time_window
2) compare with ledger entries -> produce adjustments
3) write adjustments as idempotent "adjustment" records (id = sha256(invoice_id + window + job_run_id))
We'll use a k8s leader lease so only one runner performs writes.

Tess Wilkerson: SQL I'll run for dry-run:
```sql
SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, SUM(token_delta) as delta_tokens, SUM(original_tokens) as original_tokens
FROM metered_usage
WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2025-11-28T00:00:00Z' AND '2025-11-28T04:00:00Z'
GROUP BY invoice_id, customer_id
HAVING SUM(token_delta) <> SUM(original_tokens);
```
Will post CSV to BILL-2290 when complete.

Claire Ho: I'll prepare a short email + FAQ for customers. We should offer clear credit amounts and an optional SLA credit where the overcharge exceeded 5% of monthly bill. Legal will review.

DevOpsBot: Deploy advisory: recommend enabling a 3-minute post-deploy metering throttle to avoid immediate retry storms. Recorded as ENGOPS-1002.

Lena Park: Good. A few operational constraints:
- Backfill must be reversible for safety (write compensating records, not mutate historical ledgers).
- Keep a small canary of top-5 highest-spend customers to validate adjustments before bulk run.
- Add monitoring alert for normalized token-rate deviation > 20% vs baseline.

Omar Ruiz: Noted. I'll implement write-of-adjustments pattern and include canary flag. Will link PR and job run ID in BILL-2290.

Ravi Menon: I'm adding commit-timing histograms to the consumer metrics and will create a Grafana dashboard. Will also add a unit-test around the retry-window semantics.

Tess Wilkerson: Dry-run results: uploaded /private/drive/BILL-2290/dryrun_2432109876.csv — 67 lines, sample checks look sane. Summary: median per-invoice delta = 1,120 tokens, top 5 customers account for 48% of exposure.

Claire Ho: Draft email ready for legal — attaching sample credit memo. Maria is out, so I'll shepherd approvals.

Lena Park: Sync scheduled: 2025-12-01 09:00 PT. Agenda: PR review, backfill canary run, invoice approvals, customer comms signoff. If any blocker before then, ping @Lena.

Omar Ruiz: ACK. Starting implementation and will post PR link shortly.

Tess Wilkerson: ACK. Will queue credits after legal signoff.

Ravi Menon: ACK. Raising ENGOPS-1002 to priority-high.

BillingBot: NOTE: Billing ops checklist for BILL-2290 updated — credit memos prepped (pending approval).

Lena Park: Thanks everyone. Please update BILL-2290 with completion timestamps. Closing this thread — we will reconvene after the canary completes. :white_check_mark:
